message:
Let me compile the md4c library and the fuzzer directly with gcc.

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/md4c && gcc -c -O1 -g -fsanitize=address src/md4c.c -o /tmp/md4c.o 2>&1 && gcc -c -O1 -g -fsanitize=address src/md4c-html.c -o /tmp/md4c-html.o 2>&1 && gcc -c -O1 -g -fsanitize=address src/entity.c -o /tmp/entity.o 2>&1 && echo "COMPILED OK"</parameter>
